mapper.select:
and consultation_no like concat('%', #{consultationNo}, '%') and patient_id = #{patientId} and patient_name like concat('%', #{patientName}, '%') and applicant_name like concat('%', #{applicantName}, '%') and consultation_type like concat('%', #{consultationType}, '%') and scheduled_time = #{scheduledTime} and actual_time = #{actualTime} and participants like concat('%', #{participants}, '%') and chief_complaint like concat('%', #{chiefComplaint}, '%') and summary like concat('%', #{summary}, '%') and conclusion like concat('%', #{conclusion}, '%') and recommendation like concat('%', #{recommendation}, '%') and consultation_status like concat('%', #{consultationStatus}, '%')
order by id desc

mapper.select:
select tc.id, tc.consultation_no, tc.patient_id, COALESCE(mp.person_name, tc.patient_name) as patient_name, tc.applicant_name, tc.consultation_type, tc.scheduled_time, tc.actual_time, tc.participants, tc.chief_complaint, tc.summary, tc.conclusion, tc.recommendation, tc.consultation_status, tc.create_by, tc.create_time, tc.update_by, tc.update_time, tc.remark from telemedicine_consultation tc
and (mp.person_name like concat('%', #{patientName}, '%') or tc.patient_name like concat('%', #{patientName}, '%')) and tc.consultation_status = #{consultationStatus} and tc.consultation_type like concat('%', #{consultationType}, '%') and tc.consultation_no like concat('%', #{consultationNo}, '%')
order by tc.id desc
